site.title: Lumesys Marketplace — Buy and sell in Mali

language.reviewNotice: Bambara translations are partial and need review by a native speaker.

home.welcomeHtml: Welcome to Lumesys, your trusted marketplace to shop and sell with freedom. Discover our wide selection of products and services, choose what suits you, and explore at your own pace.

categories.title: Explore our categories
categories.description: Browse the categories and find the items you are looking for.

purchase.title: Shop with ease
purchase.description: Shop with confidence on Lumesys. Contact the seller to learn about payment and delivery.

sell.title: Sell with confidence
sell.description: Want to list an item on Lumesys? Contact our team to learn how to publish and sell. Never send passwords or banking details in a message.
sell.contact: Contact the seller support team on WhatsApp
sell.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to list an item on Lumesys.

listings.title: Manage your listings
listings.description: Seller listing management is not yet available in the marketplace. Our team can help you publish, edit or remove a listing.
listings.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like help managing a Lumesys listing.

help.title: Need help?
help.description: Our local team can answer questions about products, orders and your account.
help.whatsappMessage: Hello, I need help with Lumesys.

account.title: My Lumesys account
account.guestReady: Sign in to sync your account, cart, favorites and viewing history. Guest data stays on this device.
account.connectedLoading: Account connected. Loading profile and data…
account.ready: Profile loaded. Cart, favorites and history are synced with your account.
account.historyLocal: Profile loaded. Cart and favorites are synced; history remains on this device.
account.syncUnavailable: Account sync is temporarily unavailable. Your local data is safe.
account.syncUnavailableCart: Cloud sync is unavailable; your local cart is still usable.
account.saveFailed: Your session is active, but cloud saving failed. Your local data is safe.
account.historySaveFailed: Viewing history is currently stored on this device only.
account.firebaseUnavailable: The account service is unavailable. Local features are still available.
account.firebaseInitFailed: The account service did not start. Local features remain available; check your connection and console.
account.signInFailed: Could not sign in. Please try again later.
account.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Please try again later.
